method: Refresh only Pablo GLM: six seed-42 tasks, one attempt each, provider-default reasoning. Other 30 observations retained exactly from the historical six-harness pilot. All attempts remain in factual/latency/cost metrics; different collection times and native reasoning/provider settings prevent causal attribution.

chart.subtitle: Six tasks per configuration · seed 42 · only Pablo GLM rerun; other results retained
chart.footer: Only Pablo GLM rerun · all attempts included · exploratory pilot · different collection times and reasoning settings · local CPU / RAM only

parity.note: Same measurement supervisor for every retained run; later changes add Astra profile, metadata normalization, cancellation reporting and additional summary fields. No model request, source input or scorer change in the five unaffected tasks.
